newsitem.title: USA: Strong Japan domestic demand is key, Summers says.
newsitem.headline: Strong Japan domestic demand is key, Summers says.

text.p: Deputy Treasury Secretary Lawrence Summers on Thursday voiced hopes for a strong, sustainable economic recovery in Japan led by domestic demand.
"We think it's very important that the objective of strong domestic demand be a central one as Japan sets its poliocy course going foward," he told reporters.
Some analysts have voiced fears that Japan's struggling recovery could be derailed next year by government plans to tighten fiscal policy, including raising its consumption tax.
"Of course, there are very important fiscal issues dealing with the aging of (Japan's) society," Summers said, in commenting on Tokyo's fiscal plans.

"But," he added, "it is very important to achieve economic recovery so as to maintain the strength of the economy and private investment and capacity, which are helpful in addressing the problems of an aging society."
Summers added that the United States was encouraged by the Japanese government's commitment to major financial liberalization and looked forward to discussing with Tokyo what that means.
